Recommended Action
Staff recommends that the City Council approve adjustments to the Santa Monica  Realignment  plan to transition towards operationalizing performance gains as new service delivery standards for public safety renewal, revitalization of key p ublic spaces, and achievement of organizational stability and fiscal balance, via the following direction:
Adopt a finding of no possibility of significant effect pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) (Common Sense Exemption) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines and findings of categorical exemptions pursuant to Section 15301 (Existing Facilities), Section 15306 (Information Collection), Section 15273 (Rates, Tolls, Fares, and Charges), and Section 15324 (Regulations of Working Conditions) ;
2. Adopt a Resolution revising rates for Downtown Parking Structures 1-9 and Ken Edwards Center, establishing the Fitness and Wellness Business Validation Pilot Program and the School Validation Pilot Program, establishing prorated Residential Parking Permits, and revising parking access card prices (Attachment A);
3. Adopt a Resolution waiving the City of Santa Monica portion of the wastewater capacity fee for restaurant and restaurant expansion projects. (Attachment B);
4. Endorse the conceptual framework for a Retail to Restaurant Activation Program and provide direction regarding eligibility criteria and geographic prioritization for (1) retail-to-restaurant conversion projects and (2) the reactivation of second-generation restaurant spaces, with staff conducting additional outreach to architects, restaurant operators, commercial brokers, and other stakeholders to further refine program design prior to implementation;
Authorize staff to establish an Economic Development Fund reserve of $3,000,000 from available one-time General Fund resources, with expenditures subject to subsequent Council authorization;
6. Introduce for first reading an ordinance amending Santa Monica Municipal Code (SMMC) Chapter 6.44, to Establish Entertainment Zones in the Downtown core, on Portions of the Santa Monica Pier, and Along Portions of Main Street and Montana Avenues (Attachment C);
7. Introduce for First Reading an Ordinance to Provide for Additional Regulations Related to Sitting and Lying in the Public Right-of-Way and Possession of Open Alcoholic Beverage Containers to Coordinate with the Establishment of Entertainment Zones and Upcoming Major Events (Attachment D);
8. Adopt a resolution revising fees, including a permit and license fee waiver for unimproved sidewalk dining and a waiver of the City of Santa Monica portion of the wastewater capacity fee for simple tables and chairs outdoor Dining and Seating on Sidewalks.  This is part of establishing the no-cost sidewalk dining program eliminating permit requirements and fees for qualifying basic outdoor dining configurations (Attachment E);

11.
